note: Repeatability measurement for the 2026-11-05 round. Purpose: the first formal batch (formal_3step_20261105) scored 2/6 and the identical manifest scored 5/6 in a second batch run minutes later on a fresh engine process with the same weights, the same shipped config (config_demo_b900), the same execute_horizon=5, the same budgets (1:300/2:600/3:300) and the same handoff (action_retreat). Neither number is reported as the round's success rate. This file pre-declares two further repeats of the *same* frozen manifest, in the same order, with no per-round retry and no skipping, so the spread can be measured instead of guessed. A round that fails stays in the denominator. The only thing that changes between batches is the engine process and the resident policy server's request history; nothing in the code, config or manifests changes.
reporting: Per-round outcomes are reported for every batch side by side (pass/fail, actions, failure code). No batch is selected as 'the' result and no batch is dropped.
